By injecting psionic power into their legs and core, a psionic is able to rapidly accelerate their movement for a short time. 

In combat, this augmentation allows the psionic to rapidly propel themselves short distances and transfer that energy as a form of attack at the impact location. Psionics are shielded in a barrier while performing this psionic leap.
This attack occurs only if the psionic is drafted and unarmed.
Training in this skill improves the leap distance and impact force.

Training in this skill improves duration and movement speed.

Training in this skill improves duration and the amount manipulation is boosted.

The Arcane Forge is capable of scanning a single item and replicating its design. If successful, the forge stores the design blueprints of the scanned item and the item can then be crafted at the forge.

Replicated items require the same material as the standard item to craft, but any research requirements or crafting skill requirements are bypassed. All replicated items require a high intelligence to reproduce and the forge can only be operated by a mage.

*Admin note: the forge can perform scans at no cost, but the active design is replaced by the default recipe if the game is reloaded.

Replication has no use limit, but is benefits most when used to create items you do not have the research to create, to alter the crafting requirements, to take advantage of the dramatically increased crafting speed of the arcane forge or to benefit from the quality bonus when operated by a high level mage.

text: Toggles active defenses. The golem will activate if an enemy enters its threat range. Threat range may be adjusted a golem by selecting the dormant golem and opening the golem tab.
protected_text: Toggles active defenses. The golem will activate if an enemy enters its threat range. Threat range may be adjusted a golem by selecting the dormant golem and opening the golem tab.
translated: 开关已激活的防御系统。如果敌人进入其威胁范围，傀儡将会激活。可以通过选择休眠的傀儡并打开 “傀儡” 选项卡来调整威胁范围。

text: Determines the distance the golem will detect and activate to engage a hostile target; this value also determines the distance an active golem will engage a threat. Setting this value to 0 will prevent a dormant golem from activating from a nearby threat.
protected_text: Determines the distance the golem will detect and activate to engage a hostile target; this value also determines the distance an active golem will engage a threat. Setting this value to 0 will prevent a dormant golem from activating from a nearby threat.
translated: 决定傀儡检测到敌人并激活其与敌对目标交战的距离; 此数值还决定了活跃的傀儡与威胁交战的距离。将此数值设置为 0 将会阻止一个休眠的傀儡从附近的威胁中激活。

text: Determines the minimum energy percent required to use abilities that cost energy; the golem will not use abilities that require energy if the energy percent is less than this value. Setting this value to 100% will disable ability use.
protected_text: Determines the minimum energy percent required to use abilities that cost energy; the golem will not use abilities that require energy if the energy percent is less than this value. Setting this value to 100% will disable ability use.
translated: 确定使用消耗能量的能力所需的最小能量百分比; 如果能量百分比小于此值，魔体会不会使用需要能量的能力。将此数值设置为 100% 将禁用能力使用。

text: The energy percent that the golem will attempt to return to its dormant position to de-activate and recharge energy; the golem will automatically de-activate at 0%.
protected_text: The energy percent that the golem will attempt to return to its dormant position to de-activate and recharge energy; the golem will automatically de-activate at 0%.
translated: 傀儡试图回到其休眠位置以进行无激活和补充能量的能量百分比; 傀儡将在 0% 时自动无激活。

text: The energy percent at which that the golem will activate to perform tasks; set to 10% or less to disable automatic activation.
protected_text: The energy percent at which that the golem will activate to perform tasks; set to 10% or less to disable automatic activation.
translated: 魔人在执行任务时获得激活的能量百分比; 设置为 10% 或更低，以禁用自动激活。

text: Assigns a golemancer as the master of this golem; assigning a master allows the golem improved behavior to protect the assigned golemancer.
protected_text: Assigns a golemancer as the master of this golem; assigning a master allows the golem improved behavior to protect the assigned golemancer.
translated: 指定一名傀儡种作为这个傀儡的主人; 指定一个傀儡种可以改善行为来保护指定的傀儡种。

text: When enabled, the golem will prioritize following and protecting its master above all other work related tasks. The golem must have a master assigned.
protected_text: When enabled, the golem will prioritize following and protecting its master above all other work related tasks. The golem must have a master assigned.
translated: 启用后，傀儡将优先考虑跟随和保护其主人，而不是其他所有与工作相关的任务。傀儡必须有被指派的主人。

text: Follows master only when master is drafted.
protected_text: Follows master only when master is drafted.
translated: 只有当主人被征召时，才跟随主人。

text: When enabled, the golem will remain in a dormant state if there are queued bills. A golem will always remain dormant when a bill is in progress (unfinished upgrade).
protected_text: When enabled, the golem will remain in a dormant state if there are queued bills. A golem will always remain dormant when a bill is in progress (unfinished upgrade).
translated: 启用后，如果有排队的账单，魔像将保持在休眠状态。一个傀儡将永远保持休眠状态，当一个清单正在进行 (未完成的升级)。

text: When disabled, a dormant golem will never use abilities.
protected_text: When disabled, a dormant golem will never use abilities.
translated: 当禁用时，休眠的傀儡将永远不会使用能力。

text: When enabled, the golem will not activate or pursue targets through doors or beyond its allowed zone.
protected_text: When enabled, the golem will not activate or pursue targets through doors or beyond its allowed zone.
translated: 当启用时，魔人将不会通过门或超出其允许的区域来激活或追逐目标。

text: Activates the golem - this typically takes a small amount of time. The golem will not be able to activate if it is undergoing upgrades.
protected_text: Activates the golem - this typically takes a small amount of time. The golem will not be able to activate if it is undergoing upgrades.
translated: 激活傀儡-这通常需要少量的时间。如果傀儡正在升级，它将无法激活。

text: Deactivates the golem - this will send the golem back to their resting position and may take some time.
protected_text: Deactivates the golem - this will send the golem back to their resting position and may take some time.
translated: 停用傀儡-这将把傀儡送回其休息位置，可能需要一些时间。

text: The spirit leaves the body willingly and the characteristics of the pawn return to its state prior to possession.
protected_text: The spirit leaves the body willingly and the characteristics of the <ALIMT >(PH_1)</ALIMT> return to its state prior to <ALIMT >possession</ALIMT>.
translated: 灵魂心甘情愿地离开身体，以及pawn回到其之前的状态:附身没有。

text: When disabled, golems will not cause the screen to shake when they activate or deactivate.
protected_text: When disabled, golems will not cause the screen to shake when they activate or deactivate.
translated: 禁用时，魔像不会导致屏幕在它们激活或停用时震动。

text: The empath detaches their will from the host and returns to his or her body. This option is only available if the host is near the symbiote.
protected_text: The empath detaches their will from the host and returns to his or her body. This option is only available if the host is near the symbiote.
translated: 读心者会将其意志与宿主分离，并回归其身体。只有当宿主在共生体附近时，此选项才可用。

text: Creates a stockpile around the portal. When transporting items, the portal will move all items within this stockpile.
protected_text: Creates a stockpile around the portal. When transporting items, the portal will move all items within this stockpile.
translated: 在门户周围创建储存区。在运输物品时，传送门会移动该储存区内的所有物品。

text: {0} failed when attempting to use the portal - if this persists, try deactivating the portal and resetting the target location.
protected_text: <ALIMT >(PH_1)</ALIMT> failed when attempting to use the portal - if this persists, try deactivating the portal and resetting the target location.
translated: {0}尝试使用门户失败-如果这种情况仍然存在，请尝试停用门户并重置目标位置。

text: Invalid destination cell - destination must be a known, visible, and player occupied map.
protected_text: Invalid destination cell - destination must be a known, visible, and player occupied map.
translated: 无效的目标格-目标必须是已知的、可见的、玩家已占用的地图。

text: No valid portal destination selected, exiting without assignment.
protected_text: No valid portal destination selected, exiting without assignment.
translated: 没有选择任何有效的传送门目的地，将在没有分配的情况下离开。

protected_text: Shows a frame over this golem's dormant position. Use the mod options menu to toggle this for all golems.
